ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Talktray uses the microphone only while you are recording, so it can turn what you say into tasks, reminders, and notes. It does not record in the background.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Talktray can add the events you confirm to your calendar.
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Talktray can save the reminders you confirm to the Reminders app.
